ownership_model.drive: Canonical human-readable documents, approved/source assets, research, print masters, controlled evidence, and release packages.
ownership_model.github: Canonical code, machine-readable data, tests, build/deployment configuration, and automation.
ownership_model.library: Temporary working surface only. Unique approved work must be promoted to Drive or GitHub.
ownership_model.quarantine: Verified duplicates or superseded working copies pending final retention/deletion review.
